centrality_graph: All roads_context highway/path geometries, undirected. Identical native adjacent-node pairs are one physical link; zero-length connected links are contracted. Positive links and every component remain represented.
centrality_od: Every quotient vertex of degree other than two is a uniform OD junction or endpoint. Degree-two geometry-only vertices are not OD demand. Isolated all-degree-two cycles contain no OD junction pair and have zero benchmark centrality.
centrality_algorithm: Exact float64 weighted Brandes with block-cut decomposition: every original OD is retained through attachment weights; all projected sources in every nontrivial block are evaluated, bridges use the exact branch-mass product. No sampled sources, cutoff or LCC truncation. Geometry-chain suppression preserves every junction-to-junction path and length. Direct all-junction Brandes is a control implementation, not used as an empirical result.
interpretation: Structural corridor comparator, not legal vehicle routing, traffic flow or building-weighted OD demand.
comparison_domain: Every 1684 primary bus-support source segment; retain missing/zero-equivalence flags explicitly. All nine W/K settings and both modes.
comparators: distinct accepted dependent bus relation count
rank_metrics: Spearman with average ties, full-domain and nonzero-union comparisons, positive-subset top 1/5/10 percent with cutoff ties; undefined constants remain undefined. No inferential p-values.
length_control: Fixed source-length bins from prior sensitivity; no claim of equal-length failure budgets.
district_rule: One owner for each of all 65677 original building features: municipality polygon covering the stored representative point; overlapping owners resolved by lowest numeric district number then relation ID. Number is source ref if present or the digits in its recorded source name; unmatched preserved separately. Do not duplicate buildings by footprint overlap.
district_outputs: All 22 districts, connected origins, healthy access, every observed single-closure loss and parameter/mode result, worst loss and mean over the full common 1684-unit domain. Fixed building denominator per owner; no population/equity claim.
descriptives: All components and route traces, pairwise route street-overlap, bus dependency concentration, distinct hospital candidate groups reachable per origin at each W/K/mode. Groups are possible institutions, not clinically verified hospitals.
pair_associations: Every primary physical pair, all W/K and both modes: midpoint Euclidean distance and number of shared accepted bus relations versus joint loss and signed interaction. Fixed distance bins [0,250,500,1000,2000,5000,10000,20000,infinity] metres and shared-relation counts0/1/2. No inference treating pairs as independent.
source_restriction: No added map, operational, population or clinical records.
verification: Independent explicit-path controls, full source geometry/chain census, every OD source coverage, weighted betweenness-distance conservation, all 22 district totals and all saved effect rows. Runtime measurements do not replace or truncate the final census.
